title: Coaching Institute: 20-Day Admissions Blitz
story: A prominent coaching institute has a ₹1,00,000 budget for their 20-day JEE/NEET admissions window. They need at least 400 qualified student and parent inquiries before registrations close.

steps.prompt: Who is the primary decision-maker you should target on Meta for high-ticket coaching admissions?
options: Both parents (aged 38-55) focusing on faculty and results, and high-school students (16-18) focusing on clarity and mentorship
steps.explain: In Indian education, parents pay the fees and care about rank history, while students care about relatable teachers and understanding concepts.

steps.prompt: How do you ensure leads aren't random students with fake phone numbers?
options: Use Instant Form with custom questions (Target Exam, Current Class, City) and require OTP SMS verification
Offer a free ₹500 Amazon voucher for filling the form
Remove all questions from the form
Ask for a scanned copy of passport
steps.explain: Adding mandatory academic fields and phone verification filters out accidental clicks and validates phone numbers.

finalQuestion: What lead follow-up protocol should you mandate to the coaching centre's telecalling team?
keyPoints: Mandate Speed to Lead under 10 minutes
Send an automated WhatsApp confirmation brochure immediately
Log qualified status back into CRM to train Meta Custom Audiences
modelAnswer: I mandate a sub-10-minute Speed to Lead: our telecalling team must call the parent while the ad is fresh in their mind. Simultaneously, an automated WhatsApp integration sends our JEE rank-holder brochure and sample mock test link within 30 seconds. Finally, telecallers mark qualified leads in CRM so we can feed offline conversions back to Meta for algorithmic optimization.
